final: WITH category_stats AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_quantity, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) as avg_difference FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id JOIN Product_Categories pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code WHERE ili.product_id IS NOT NULL AND p.production_type_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pc.product_type_description), mean_calc AS (SELECT AVG(avg_difference) as overall_mean FROM category_stats), filtered_categories AS (SELECT cs.avg_quantity, cs.avg_difference, mc.overall_mean FROM category_stats cs CROSS JOIN mean_calc mc WHERE cs.avg_difference > mc.overall_mean) SELECT AVG(avg_quantity), AVG(avg_difference), AVG(avg_difference - overall_mean) FROM filtered_categories
